answer: The pulse schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the marble checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 22 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Anyone wanting 144 effective identities must lock that capital for 22 epochs and keep it locked through every dune audit. That is 3 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
